messages:
Nabeel: opened a quick PR to update the audit export docs and add an SDK compatibility note. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/889
Ava: noted. legal flagged the wording that implied absolute deletion dates. suggest: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Rosa: also flag old SDK param `retention_days` -> new `retention_policy` string. i'll add a tiny migration snippet and both py + curl examples.
Nabeel: adding migration note and a one-liner about redacted exports (customers can request exports with redaction applied). will avoid internal infra details.
Ava: please cross-ref the SOC2 FAQ and add this caveat: 'exports may be affected by legal holds or regulatory obligations.'
Rosa: sample snippets (short):
# Python (new)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-000", retention_policy="audit:30d", redacted=True)
print(resp.url)

# Migration hint
# before: resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-000", retention_days=30)
# after:  resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-000", retention_policy="audit:30d")

curl example:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-000","retention_policy":"audit:30d","redacted":true}'
Nabeel: added wording per Ava, SOC2 link, and a troubleshooting bullet: if export URL 403s check tenant export permissions and retention policy alignment.
LegalBot: automated check passed for phrasing. human legal to sign off but no blocking issues detected.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/889/export-compatibility preview expires in 7 days.
Ava: LGTM pending one tiny edit: replace 'redacted' with 'with redaction applied' in the public docs copy.
Nabeel: done. will merge after final legal OK and CI snippet smoke test. Thanks all.
